peak_mem_mb.budget_note: memory ceiling of one ordinary session (whole tree)

think_instr.budget_note: renderer work for a streaming step-shaped thinking turn (#1645 class)

submit_echo_max_ms.budget_note: Enter to message-entry (blocking pre-request work); dormant until the binary carries the submit-timing marks

load_instr.budget_note: resume of a large compacted session (v1.11 was 3-9x)

turn_instr.budget_note: first turn after resume; render of pre-compaction history

instr.budget_note: per-pass ledger work at production record counts. INTERIM abs from the release sweep (healthy v1.23-v1.34 era 52-54G, full-re-read v1.18-21 era 94G, v2.0.0-rc.7 86.6G, fix branch 49.7G, all on one dev machine); recalibrate to ratio limits on the canonical runner. 100G lets the healthy era clear ~2x and would have caught the v1.18 full-re-read class (94G); catching the rc.7 class (86G) needs the calibrated ratio budget (~1.35x of ~53G)

read_mb.budget_note: per-pass re-reads of the scaled ledger (real-disk runners; page-cache-immune twin of instr). INTERIM abs until first canonical calibration

keylat_p95_ms.budget_note: keystroke echo latency while reconcile passes run over the big ledger; absolute event-loop-hold detector (the user-reported stall class)

additive_missing.budget_note: additive ledger indexes ABSENT after a run over the scaled fixture; the fix applies work_records_imported, outbox_pending_cover and outbox_batches_by_account on open — 0 missing on fixed binaries, 3 on unfixed

stuck_instr.budget_note: background work with a stuck queue and no due retries (sleep-schedule class)

stuck_read_mb.budget_note: reads with a stuck queue and no due retries
